name: Red Burlap Bandana
summary: Near the abbey vineyards in Northshire Valley, Deputy Willem gathers red bandanas from slain Defias thieves. The cloth marks the Brotherhood's low-ranking highwaymen and cutpurses.

sections.title: A Mark of the Brotherhood
sections.body: In Northshire, young recruits and common thugs of the Defias Brotherhood wear red burlap masks. The cheap, rough cloth hides their faces and marks their allegiance to the growing rebellion. They carry these scarves into the eastern orchards, where local guards recognize the red fabric as proof of thieves slain nearby.

faq.q: Why does Deputy Willem want these bandanas?
faq.answer: Deputy Willem collects the bandanas as proof that an adventurer has killed Defias thugs near Northshire Abbey. The thieves wear the red cloth openly, confirming the bounty has been claimed.

faq.q: Who wears the red burlap bandanas?
faq.answer: Footpads and thugs of the Defias Brotherhood wear red burlap bandanas. The coarse cloth conceals their faces and marks their loyalty to the outlaws.

faq.q: Why are Defias thieves operating in Northshire?
faq.answer: Defias scouts and brigands camp across the stream east of Northshire Abbey to scavenge and steal supplies. The abbey garrison is stretched thin, leaving nearby orchards open to highwaymen.
Crimson dye gives the cheap burlap bandanas their red color. The hue is the Defias Brotherhood's banner and uniform, helping its members recognize one another in the field.

angles.text: As a developing rogue, you can learn from Northshire's clumsy footpads how quickly undisciplined outlaws become easy targets for local law enforcement.
As an Alliance member, you can see red bandanas reaching Northshire Abbey's doorstep, a sign that Stormwind is losing control of the kingdom's rural borders.
